parameters.content:
## 1 · Intake & validation
Webhook receives the demo request, validates it, and answers the form instantly.

## 2 · Enrichment
Fetch the company homepage and reduce it to clean text. Unreachable sites fall through gracefully.

## 3 · AI qualification (Gemini)
Schema-enforced JSON verdict: ICP score, tier, signals, risks and a first-touch email. Retries 3x, then hands the same prompt to a second provider (Groq) if the primary is down. Providers are swappable (Gemini / Groq / Claude / OpenAI).

## 4 · Routing & actions
Score ≥ 70: CRM row + personalized Gmail draft for the sales rep. Otherwise: nurture list.
